summary: Something can still touch a nerve without ruining the rest of your day.
body: Something can still touch a nerve without ruining the rest of your day. When the Moon trines Chiron, an old emotional reaction may be easier to recognize before it decides what happens next. You might feel left out, criticized, overlooked, or reminded of an earlier disappointment and still be able to eat dinner, finish the work, answer the message, or ask for what you need. Take the feeling seriously without handing it the whole schedule.
